prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a red-carpet editorial portrait of a generic adult woman with voluminous mid-length blonde waves, side-parted face-framing layers, light expressive eyes and natural soft-glam makeup. She wears an elegant champagne or pale-cream off-shoulder gown with ruched draped jersey fabric, fine vertical pleating and a circular silver or diamond sunburst brooch at the neckline, plus small diamond studs and pale nude nails. Create medium waist-up variants from slight profile to front-facing: one blowing a kiss with a hand near the mouth and one smiling brightly at the camera. Use a blue approved event step-and-repeat backdrop, bright even studio-quality lighting, Old Hollywood glamour and modern sophistication. Do not reproduce any public-figure likeness.
